output: The provided datasets do not contain sufficient data to compare the principal component values of PC1 in the Younger Bronze Age (1100-500 BCE) at the beginning of the period (1100 BCE) with the subsequent time horizons (1000 to 500 BCE). The "capital.csv" dataset lacks valid principal component values for the specified time range, and the "pollen_openness_score_Belau_Woserin_Feeser_et_al_2019.csv" dataset does not provide relevant principal component values for the forms of capital analyzed in the "capital.csv" dataset. Therefore, it is not possible to derive a scientific hypothesis based on the provided dataset.
